column1: # UNIKERN1 link oracle (spec §4.8 AS-7, AS-8). Two-unit fixtures assembled by `unisacc as` and
# linked by the kernel linker; the complete UNIKERN1 file is hand-derived: 40-byte header
# ("UNIKERN1", arch u64 1=arm64 2=x86_64, entry u64, slot u64, length u64, little-endian) then the
# image. Image layout AS-8: per unit in argument order, every allocated section (.text, .data,
# .bss in section-header order) at the next multiple of its sh_addralign (16); .bss contributes
# only zero bytes. Relocated fields are computed by AS-7 from symbol addresses, never read back.
# Columns: id isa units image_hex entry slot length cite. units: unit texts separated by " || ",
# lines by " | ". image_hex is written as concatenated groups separated by "." for review.

column3: .text | .globl _kernel_entry | _kernel_entry: call f | leaq D(%rip),%rax | call * _kernel_service (%rip) | jmp g | .data | .p2align 3 | D: .quad 7 | .globl _kernel_service | _kernel_service: .quad 0 || .text | .globl f | .globl g | f: ret | g: ret
column8: unit1 .text 0..23, .data 32..48, .bss 48+0; unit2 .text 48..50, .data/.bss at 64. AS-7 x86 field = S+A-P (SDM CALL/JMP rel32 and RIP-relative disp32 count from the next instruction): PLT32 f 48-4-1=43; PC32 D 32-4-8=20; PC32 slot 40+4-14=22; PLT32 g 49-4-19=26

column3: .text | .globl _kernel_entry | _kernel_entry: bl f | b g | adrp x0,D | add x0,x0,:lo12:D | ldr x1,[x0, :lo12:_kernel_service] | ret | .data | .p2align 3 | D: .quad 7 | .globl _kernel_service | _kernel_service: .quad 0 || .text | .globl f | .globl g | f: ret | g: ret
column8: f=48 g=52 D=32 slot=40. Arm ARM C6.2 BL imm26=(48-0)/4=12; B imm26=(52-4)/4=12; ADRP pages=(32>>12)-(8>>12)=0; ADD imm12=32&4095; LDR (immediate, unsigned offset) imm12=(40&4095)/8=5
